frozen_at: written before any measured value in this round was read
decision: Which INTERFACE/INTERFACE (I/I) selector should TensorLBM's Thürey/Körner free-surface mass exchange use, and does the choice matter for the integrated accuracy benchmark (Martin & Moyce 1952 column collapse)?

alternatives.repo: current repo gate: I/I link dead iff pull source has no LIQUID neighbour while receiver has no GAS neighbour (asymmetric in the pair)
alternatives.pair_symmetric: same intent evaluated symmetrically (dead iff both ends lack a LIQUID neighbour and neither end touches GAS); exactly +dm/-dm per pair
alternatives.koerner: Koerner et al. 2005 eq. 9 with no selector (all I/I links live)
alternatives.oss: port of Maarten-vd-Sande/lbm lbm/streamcollide.py::interface_mass_exchange (Thuerey table 4.1 four-branch selector)

hypotheses.H1: The repo and oss selectors are pair-asymmetric in at least one physically reachable flag configuration, so the I/I stage creates/destroys liquid there; koerner and pair_symmetric do not.
hypotheses.H2: Switching the I/I selector does not move the Martin & Moyce front-position error by more than 2 absolute percentage points at a>=24 (the integrated benchmark is insensitive to the selector, so the choice must be defended on the conservation invariant, not on Z(T)).

metrics.operator_net_relative: |sum(dm_II)| / sum(|dm_II|) per configuration and rule (conservation residual of the I/I stage)
metrics.operator_pair_asym_pairs: fraction of I/I pairs whose two ends do not commit opposite increments
metrics.dambreak_Z_error_max_pct: max over sampled T of |Z(T) - Z_MM(T)| / Z_MM(T) * 100, Z = x_front/a, T = t sqrt(g/h0), piecewise-linear interpolation of the 14 digitised Martin & Moyce points, no extrapolation
metrics.inventory_drift_pct: 100 (I(t) - I(0)) / I(0), I = sum(rho over LIQUID) + sum(m over INTERFACE)

thresholds.conservation_pass: operator_net_relative < 1e-6 for a rule declared conservative (pair_symmetric, koerner)
thresholds.conservation_fail_demo: operator_net_relative > 1e-3 in the configuration where an asymmetric selector fires (repo, oss)
thresholds.no_regression: |Z_err(pair_symmetric) - Z_err(repo)| <= 2 percentage points at every resolution

varied: lattice resolution across the dam width a in {24, 32} (h0 = 2a fixed)
fixed: BGK, no surface tension, rho_liquid = rho_gas = 1
sample every 0.25 T, t_end = 2.96 T (digitised M&M window)
not_varied: 3D (free_surface_lbm.py) — out of scope this round, reported as a limitation
surface tension, multi-phase coupling, slope-limited VOF reconstruction

controls.C0: hydrostatic column, g on, no initial perturbation: I/I net exchange and fill drift must stay at round-off
controls.C1: mass exchange disabled (enable_mass_exchange=False) as the null arm of the integrated benchmark

stopping_rule: fixed step counts n = ceil(2.96 / sqrt(g/h0)); no early stopping; thresholds are constants in this file and are not tuned after seeing results
environment: CPU (torch, set_num_threads(1)), float32, lattice units, one process per arm; python3 -m pytest for the invariant tests
external_anchor: Koerner, Thies, Hofmann, Thuerrey, Ulrich (2005) Lattice Boltzmann model for free surface flow for modeling foaming, J. Comput. Phys. 202:616-628 (eq. 9, paired I/I exchange)
Thuerey (2007) A lattice Boltzmann method for free surface flows, PhD thesis, Univ. Erlangen (table 4.1 selector, eq. 4.5 ABB)
Anderl et al. (2014) Free surface lattice Boltzmann with minimal memory requirements ... waLBerla free_surface module (useSimpleMassExchange)

Martin & Moyce (1952) An experimental study of the collapse of liquid columns on a rigid horizontal plane, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 244:312-324 (14 digitised points in src/artifacts/martin_moyce_1952_dam_break.json)
OSS oracle: Maarten-vd-Sande/lbm (Thuerey minimal D2Q9 free surface), lbm/streamcollide.py::interface_mass_exchange, commit as cached in /root/oss-cache (inventoried snapshot)
